item.name: Affixed Rifle
entries: {@b Damage:} 1d8 energy damage. Properties: {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb} (range 90/360); fixed; rapid 4; reload 8; strength 11; two-handed.

item.name: Ammo Pouch
entries: An ammo pouch is a small pouch, usually worn around the waist or chest, which holds 20 slug cartridges. When you reload a weapon, you can draw as much ammunition needed from this pouch without using an object interaction to do so. Instead of slug cartridges, you can instead store a {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb} which takes up the space of 10 cartridges.

item.name: Anti-materiel blaster
entries: {@b Damage:} 3d4 energy damage. Properties: {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb} (range 180/720); auto; reload 2; penetrating 2; strength 19; two-handed.

item.name: Anti-materiel rifle
entries: {@b Damage:} 2d6 kinetic damage. Properties: {@item Slug cartridge|sw5e-phb} (range 180/720); reload 2; penetrating 2; strength 19; two-handed.

item.name: ARC caster
entries: Whenever you deal damage with this weapon and roll the maximum on the weapon damage die, the creature hit becomes {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked} until the end of its next turn.

item.name: Arrow
entries: Arrows are ammunition used in bow weapons. When you would use poison to coat a weapon or {@item Slug cartridge|sw5e-phb|slug cartridge} you can instead coat an arrow with the poison. Once a {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb|poisoned} arrow hits a target, it no longer gives a bonus.

item.name: Arrow, Combustive
entries: A combustive arrow is a specialized arrow for use with bow weapons. When the arrow hits another creature, object, or surface it detonates. Each creature within 5ft of the arrows detonation must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or take 1d8 fire damage. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage. Once the arrow hits a target, it no longer gives a bonus.

item.name: Arrow, Electroshock
entries: An {@spell Electroshock|sw5e-phb|electroshock} arrow is a specialized arrow for use with bow weapons. When you hit a creature with this arrow, the creature must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, the creature takes 1d3 ion damage and becomes {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned} until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and isn’t {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned}. Once the arrow hits a target, it no longer gives a bonus.

item.name: Arrow, Noisemaker
entries: A noisemaker arrow is a specialized arrow for use with bow weapons. When the arrow hits another creature, object, or surface it generates an explosion of sound that can be heard up to 100 feet away. If the target of the attack is a creature, the creature must make a DC 14 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, the creature takes 1d6 sonic damage and is {@condition Deafened|sw5e-phb|deafened} until the end of its next turn. Once the arrow hits a target, it no longer gives a bonus.

item.name: Atlatl
entries: This specialized gungan club can be used to throw grenades or similar objects at long distances. If you are wielding this weapon, as part of the action to throw a grenade, you can instead throw it using an atlatl you are holding. The grenade can be thrown at a short distance of 30ft and a long distance of 120ft. When throwing a grenade at long range, creatures within the radius of the grenade’s explosion have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.  If you lack proficiency in the atlatl, you must roll the damage dice twice and take the lesser total.

item.name: Binders (Champion)
entries: {@item Binders|sw5e-phb} can be used to restrain a Small or Medium creature with appropriate appendages. Applying {@item Binders|sw5e-phb|binders} takes an action, and the target must make a DC 24 Strength or Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (the target chooses the ability to use). A hostile creature makes this save with {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}. A set of {@item Binders|sw5e-phb|binders} comes with one key. Breaking the {@item Binders|sw5e-phb|binders} requires a DC 30 Strength check. Escaping them requires a DC 30 Dexterity check. Without the key, unlocking the {@item Binders|sw5e-phb|binders} requires a DC 30 {@item Security kit|sw5e-phb|security kit} to force open. {@item Binders|sw5e-phb} have an AC of 15 and 90 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}. Destroying the {@item Binders|sw5e-phb|binders} frees the creature without harming it.

item.name: Blaster cannon
entries: Rather than traditional {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|power cells}, the {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} cannon uses a specialized power generator that allows it to fire continuously for 10 minutes. Replacing a power generator takes an action.

Before firing the {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} cannon, you must deploy it using an action unless you meet its strength requirement. Alternatively, if you’re able to make multiple attacks with the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action, this action replaces one of them.  While deployed in this way, you treat this weapon’s strength number as two steps less (from 19 to 15), your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is reduced by half, and you cannot fire this weapon at long range. You can collapse the {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} cannon as an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

item.name: Bo-rifle
entries: The bo-rifle is a lasat weapon most commonly carried by the Honor Guard of Lasan, which has the unique property of functioning as both a rifle and a staff. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can switch between each mode, detailed below.
{@b {@i Rifle.}} While in this mode, the weapon uses traditional {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|power cells}.
{@b {@i Staff.}} While in this mode, the weapon gains the shocking property.

item.name: Bolas
entries: A Large or smaller creature hit by a bolas is {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb|restrained} until it is freed. A bolas has no effect on formless or Huge or larger creatures. A creature can use its action to make a DC 13 Dexterity check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. The bolas has an AC of 10, 5 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, and immunity to all damage not dealt by melee weapons. Destroying the bolas frees the creature without harming it and immediately ends the bolas’s effects. While a creature is {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb|restrained} by a bolas, you can make no further attacks with it.

Due to their unwieldy nature, bolas make ineffective melee weapons. Melee {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} made with them are made at {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

item.name: Bolt
entries: Rather than traditional {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|power cells}, the bolt-thrower fires specialized projectiles in the form of bolts.

item.name: Bolt, Deafening
entries: This bolt-thrower ammunition deals 2d6 kinetic damage on a hit. Also on a hit, the creature must make a DC 14 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, taking 2d4 sonic damage on a failed save. Additionally, on a failed save, a creature is {@condition Deafened|sw5e-phb|deafened} for 1 minute. At the end of an affected creature’s turn, it can repeat this save, ending the effect on a success.

item.name: Bolt, Electrifying
entries: This bolt-thrower ammunition deals 2d6 kinetic damage on a hit. Also on a hit, the creature must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, taking 2d4 lightning damage on a failed save. Additionally, on a failed save, a creature is {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked} for 1 minute. At the end of an affected creature’s turn, it can repeat this save, ending the effect on a success.

item.name: Bolt, Panic
entries: This bolt-thrower ammunition deals 2d6 kinetic damage on a hit. Also on a hit, the creature must make a DC 14 Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, taking 2d4 psychic damage on a failed save. Additionally, on a failed save, a creature becomes {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb|frightened} of you for 1 minute. At the start of an affected creature’s turn, it can repeat this save, ending the effect on a success.

item.name: Bolt-thrower
entries: Rather than traditional {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|power cells}, the bolt-thrower fires specialized projectiles in the form of bolts.

item.name: Bucket
entries: A bucket stores 3 gallons of liquid or 1/2 cubic foot of solids.

item.name: Byrothsis Adept Cell
entries: When this weapon is levitated by the Force to deal damage through a class feature or {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} you use, it deals additional damage equal to one of its weapon damage dice.

item.name: Byrothsis Ancient Cell
entries: When this weapon is levitated by the Force to deal damage through a class feature or {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} you use, it deals additional damage equal to two of its weapon damage dice.

item.name: Camtono (Champion)
entries: A camtono is a secured, handle container used for transporting valuable goods. A camtono comes with one key. Without the key, unlocking the camtono requires a DC 30 {@item Security kit|sw5e-phb|security kit} to force open. It stores 10 lb., not exceeding 3/8 cubic foot, has an AC of 15, and 90 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}. Destroying the camtono risks damaging any goods stored inside.

item.name: Careful Subroutine
entries: When you cast a power that forces other creatures to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can protect some of those creatures from the power’s full force. To do so, you spend 1 additional tech point and choose a number of those creatures up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one). A chosen creature automatically succeeds on its {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against the power.

You can only spend a number of tech points in this way equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain the ability to do so when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
You can use only one Subroutine modification on a power when you cast it, unless otherwise noted.

item.name: Cesta
entries: This specialized gungan staff can be used to throw grenades or similar objects at long distances. If you are wielding this weapon, as part of the action to throw a grenade, you can instead throw it using a cesta you are holding. The grenade can be thrown at a short distance of 60ft and a long distance of 240ft. When throwing a grenade at long range, creatures within the radius of the grenade’s explosion have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. If you lack proficiency in the cesta, you must roll the damage dice twice and take the lesser total.

item.name: Chained dagger
entries: {@b Damage:} 1d4 kinetic damage. Properties: Disarming; finesse; reach.

item.name: Chained lightdagger
entries: {@b Damage:} 1d4 energy damage. Properties: Disarming; finesse; luminous; reach.

item.name: Charge, fragmentation
entries: A device used to blow holes in larger constructs and structures, a breaching charge creates a devastating explosion focused in a specific direction. Installing a breaching charge takes 1 minute. The charge can be set with a 6-second timer, or detonated remotely using a {@item Remote detonator|sw5e-phb|remote detonator}.

When detonated, the breaching charge explodes in a 15-foot cone. Each creature within the cone must make a DC 14 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, taking 20d4 kinetic damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one. If affixed to a creature, that creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. Objects, structures, and other surfaces have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. If affixed to the object, structure, or surface, it instead automatically fails this {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.

The charge can be set with a 6-second timer, or detonated remotely using a {@item Remote detonator|sw5e-phb|remote detonator}.

When detonated, the charge explodes in a 15-foot cone. Each creature within the cone must make a DC 18 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, taking 20d8 energy damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one. If affixed to a creature, that creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. Objects, structures, and other surfaces have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. If affixed to the object, structure, or surface, it instead automatically fails this {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.

item.name: Gravity generator
entries: Gravity generators are special devices typically worn on belts that function as a portable, personal artificial gravity source. Activating or deactivating the belt requires a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} and, while active, you are able to move as if in a standard gravitational pull. The generator lasts for 10 minutes and can be recharged by a power source or replacing the {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb}.

Each creature within 10 feet must make a DC 16 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. item.name: Mine, Corrosive (Average)
entries: Mines can be set to detonate when a creature comes within up to 15 feet of it or paired with a {@item Remote detonator|sw5e-phb|remote detonator}. As an action, you can prime and set a mine on a surface you can reach, which arms at the start of your next turn. When detonated, each creature within 15 feet of it must make a DC 16 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A creature takes 4d8 acid damage on a failed save, or half as much as on a successful one. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, it must make a DC 13 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, it dies immediately without making {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|death saving throws}. A disintegrated creature and everything unenhanced it is wearing or carrying are reduced to a pile of fine gray dust. A creature destroyed in this way can not be revitalized.

entries: When triggered, this enhanced {@item Wrist launcher|sw5e-phb|wrist launcher} ammunition produces a spray of acid in a line 15 feet long and 5 feet wide or a 15-foot cone. A single fuel canister holds enough fuel for three attacks in a line or a single attack in a cone. Each creature must make a DC 16 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, a creature takes 2d6 acid damage, and the first attack it makes before the end of its next turn has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and isn't disadvantaged. If this damage reduces a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, it must make a DC 13 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, it dies immediately without making {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|death saving throws}. A disintegrated creature and everything it is wearing and carrying are reduced to a pile of fine gray dust. If you lack proficiency in the {@item Wrist launcher|sw5e-phb|wrist launcher}, you must roll the damage dice twice and take the lesser total.

item.name: Refocused Subroutine
entries: When you are forced to make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to maintain {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} on a power you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and spend 2 tech points to automatically succeed on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.

You can only spend a number of tech points in this way equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain the ability to do so when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
You can use Refocused Subroutine even if you have already used a different Subroutine modification during the casting of the power.

item.name: Remote Detonator (Champion)
entries: A small handhold device with a single button, used to activate explosives. Over the course of 1 minute, you can pair the detonator with up to 12 mines within 10 feet. As an action, you can remotely detonate all of the paired mines. You must be within 1,000 feet of the mines to detonate them.

item.name: Remote Detonator (Exceptional)
entries: A small handhold device with a single button, used to activate explosives. Over the course of 1 minute, you can pair the detonator with up to ten mines within 10 feet. As an action, you can remotely detonate all of the paired mines. You must be within 300 feet of the mines to detonate them.

item.name: Remote Detonator (Fine)
entries: A small handhold device with a single button, used to activate explosives. Over the course of 1 minute, you can pair the detonator with up to four mines within 10 feet. item.name: Remote Detonator (Improved)

item.name: Remote Detonator (Superior)
entries: A small handhold device with a single button, used to activate explosives. Over the course of 1 minute, you can pair the detonator with up to eight mines within 10 feet. As an action, you can remotely detonate all of the paired mines. You must be within 150 feet of the mines to detonate them.

item.name: Repulsor pack
entries: Repulsor packs are used to {@spell Slow Descent|sw5e-phb|slow descent} from a high elevation. Activating or deactivating the repulsor pack requires a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} and, while active, your rate of descent slow to 60 feet per round, and you ignore the effects of wind of less than moderate {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} (no more than 10 mph). The repulsor pack lasts for 1 minute per {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb} (to a maximum of 10 minutes) and can be recharged by a power source or replacing the {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|power cells}.

item.name: Restraining Bolt (Champion)
entries: Restraining bolts are small, cylindrical devices that can be affixed to a droid in order to limit its functions and enforce its obedience. When inserted, a {@item Restraining bolt|sw5e-phb|restraining bolt} restricts the droid from any movement its master does not desire, and also forced it to respond to signals produced by a hand-held control unit.

Installing a {@item Restraining bolt|sw5e-phb|restraining bolt} takes 1 minute. The droid must make a DC 24 Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A hostile droid makes this save with {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}. On a successful save, the {@item Restraining bolt|sw5e-phb|restraining bolt} overloads and is rendered useless. On a failed save, the {@item Restraining bolt|sw5e-phb|restraining bolt} is correctly installed, and the control unit can be used to actively control the droid. While the control unit is inactive, the droid can act freely but it can not attempt to remove the {@item Restraining bolt|sw5e-phb|restraining bolt}.

Destroying the snare frees the creature without harming it and immediately ends the snare's effects.

item.name: Snare (Fine)
entries: When hit by this {@item Wrist launcher|sw5e-phb|wrist launcher} ammunition, a Medium or smaller creature is {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb|restrained} until it is freed. A snare has no effect on formless or Large or larger creatures. A creature can use its action to make a DC 14 Strength or Dexterity check (the target chooses the ability to use), freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. The snare has an AC of 11, 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, immunity to all damage not dealt by melee weapons, and resistance to damage dealt by unenhanced melee weapons. Destroying the snare frees the creature without harming it and immediately ends the snare's effects.

item.name: Thermal Detonator (Average)
entries: Thermal detonators are unique in that can only be turned off by whoever turned them on. They can be set to detonate on impact or with a timer that causes them to explode on {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} count 20 (losing all {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} ties). As an action, you can prime and throw a grenade at a point you can see within 30 feet + your Strength modifier x 5. Each creature within 20 feet must make a DC 16 Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. A creature takes 4d6 fire and 4d10 kinetic damage on a failed save, or half as much as on a successful one. Additionally, on a failed save, the creature is knocked {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}.

item.name: Torpedo launcher
entries: Rather than traditional {@item Power cell|sw5e-phb|power cells}, the torpedo launcher fires specialized projectiles in the form of torpedoes. Torpedo launchers have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against Gargantuan creatures and {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against Large and smaller creatures. Unlike other weapons, the torpedo launcher can only be loaded using an action, and you don’t add your Dexterity modifier to damage rolls you make with it.

The torpedo launcher requires the use of a {@item Tripod|sw5e-phb|tripod}, which is included in the price. Over the course of 1 minute, you can deploy or collapse the torpedo launcher on the {@item Tripod|sw5e-phb|tripod}. While deployed, your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is reduced to 0.

item.name: Torpedo Launcher (Fine)
entries: You have a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} made with this enhanced weapon. Additionally, the damage of torpedoes fired by this weapon increases by one step (from {@dice d4} to {@dice d6}, {@dice d6} to {@dice d8}, {@dice d8} to {@dice d10}, {@dice d10} to {@dice d12}, or {@dice d12} to {@dice d20}). If this would increase the damage die above a {@dice d20}, instead add an additional five dice to the torpedo's damage for each step above a {@dice d20}.

item.name: Tranquilizer rifle
entries: The {@spell Tranquilizer|sw5e-phb|tranquilizer} rifle includes a specialized compartment for poison. One dose of poison, when installed in this compartment, retains its potency for 1 hour before drying. One dose of poison is effective for the next 4 shots fired by the weapon. Additionally, creatures reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} by this weapon are immediately stabilized, unless that damage would instantly kill them.

item.name: Twinned Subroutine
entries: When you cast a power that can only have one target and doesn’t have a range of self, you can spend a number of additional tech points equal to the power’s level to choose a second target in range with the same power (1 tech point if the power is at-will).

You can only spend a number of tech points in this way equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain the ability to do so when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
You can use only one Subroutine modification on a power when you cast it, unless otherwise noted.
